package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.repository.OwnerRepository;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.CityAtCapacityException;

/**
 * Rejects a create-owner request whose city already contains {@value #CAPACITY} or more owners,
 * with a 409 Conflict. City is compared case-insensitively (matching the customer-code rule).
 * Runs after {@link BuildOwner} and before the owner is saved, so the count reflects only
 * pre-existing owners.
 */
public class CheckOwnerCityCapacity {

    /** Maximum number of owners a single city may hold. */
    private static final int CAPACITY = 50;

    public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)
            throws CityAtCapacityException {
        String city = owner.getCity();
        if (city == null) {
            return;
        }
        int count = 0;
        for (Owner existing : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
            if (existing.getId() != null && existing.getId().equals(owner.getId())) {
                continue; // same record (e.g. re-save), not counted against the city
            }
            if (city.equalsIgnoreCase(existing.getCity())) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        if (count >= CAPACITY) {
            throw new CityAtCapacityException(city, count);
        }
    }
}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When
            present it is prepended to the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On create/update this is stored and returned as the
            composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, with a single
            space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. When present
            (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'. Normalized on
            create/update (whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). When present it is appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space. Normalized like 'addressLine1'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 3'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            4-digit code that is valid for the city's region via the fixed table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            stripping every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When present, an 'ageBand' is derived from it as of the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name at the same address (i.e. they share a household).
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by
                the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's title and last name joined by a single space (e.g.
                'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the city via the fixed table
                (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region is not in
                the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters
                of the city, a hyphen, the upper-cased first three letters of the last name, a
                hyphen, then a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners
                already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode (non-digit characters are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named for the calendar
                year in which it ends, so a registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to
                the next calendar year's fiscal year (e.g. 2025-07-01 -> 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable shared identifier for owners in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                last name and postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode carry the
                identical value automatically; a second such owner is rejected as a 409 household
                duplicate unless it opts in with 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived duplicate-detection key: the full lower-case SHA-256 hex over
                the normalized (E.164) telephone, a '|', the email (lower-cased, or empty when
                absent), a '|', then the Soundex encoding of the last name. A create is rejected
                with 409 only when this WHOLE key equals an existing owner's, so two owners who
                share a last name and postcode but differ in telephone are both allowed (surfaced
                instead as a soft match).
              type: string
              example: '3b8c1e0d5a2f9c7b4e6a1d8f0c3b5e7a9d2f4c6b8e0a1d3f5c7b9e0a2d4f6c8b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Points score starting at 0: gains 2 when an email is present, 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 for tenure of more than
                one elapsed fiscal year (from registrationDate).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points),
                2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                (business-day-adjusted) registration date before this owner was created,
                signalling a bulk signup surge; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate as of the registrationDate:
                'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no
                birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, on create, an existing (non-deleted) owner shared this owner's
                lastName and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft match that is
                not a hard duplicate); the owner is still created. Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on lastName and postcode
                (with a different telephone) when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}: the
                record is retained but flagged deleted, and the create endpoint's duplicate
                and identity checks ignore it. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
